notes.title: Voice update
notes.content:
Hello!

We're happy to announce a major update for Locked In VR!

After listening to your reviews and comments, we decided to give the game some overhaul. 

Apart from bug fixing, we've completely changed the voice-over,now finally recorded with professional US voice actors.
New sounds are significantly creepier & will help you immerse into the horror of that basement. 
Locked in VR now works with Oculus Touch controlers and the game soon will be available at the Oculus store.
The next major update will upgrade the game engine and further optimise the game performance.
